scope: actual published Store17 source binding for Phase5D; target storage not activated

objects.name: idx_sent_replies_external_action
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sent_replies_external_action on sent_replies(external_action_key) where external_action_key<>''

objects.name: idx_sent_replies_history
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_sent_replies_history
                    on sent_replies(
                        conversation_id, trigger_message_id, sent_at
                    )

objects.name: sent_replies
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sent_replies (
                    id integer primary key autoincrement,
                    conversation_id text not null,
                    trigger_message_id text not null,
                    reply_text text not null,
                    sent_at text not null default current_timestamp
                , send_result_json text not null default '', recall_key text not null default '', recall_status text not null default '', recall_error text not null default '', recalled_at text, feedback_token text not null default '', channel text not null default 'dingtalk', agent_run_id integer not null default 0, external_action_key text not null default '')

objects.name: sent_reply_observers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sent_reply_observers (
                    sent_reply_id integer not null,
                    agent_run_id integer not null,
                    reply_task_id integer not null,
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    primary key(sent_reply_id, agent_run_id),
                    foreign key(sent_reply_id) references sent_replies(id),
                    foreign key(agent_run_id) references runs(id),
                    foreign key(reply_task_id) references tasks(id)
                )

objects.name: trg_runs_child_sent_reply_observers_agent_run_id_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_runs_child_sent_reply_observers_agent_run_id_insert before insert on "sent_reply_observers" when new."agent_run_id" is not null and exists(select 1 from runs where id=new."agent_run_id" and record_type<>'agent_runs') begin select raise(abort,'run parent must be a logical agent run'); end

objects.name: trg_runs_child_sent_reply_observers_agent_run_id_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_runs_child_sent_reply_observers_agent_run_id_update before update of "agent_run_id" on "sent_reply_observers" when new."agent_run_id" is not null and exists(select 1 from runs where id=new."agent_run_id" and record_type<>'agent_runs') begin select raise(abort,'run parent must be a logical agent run'); end

objects.name: trg_tasks_child_sent_reply_observers_reply_task_id_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tasks_child_sent_reply_observers_reply_task_id_insert before insert on "sent_reply_observers" when new."reply_task_id" is not null and exists(select 1 from tasks where id=new."reply_task_id" and record_type<>'reply_tasks') begin select raise(abort,'task parent must be a reply task'); end

objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tasks_child_sent_reply_observers_reply_task_id_update before update of "reply_task_id" on "sent_reply_observers" when new."reply_task_id" is not null and exists(select 1 from tasks where id=new."reply_task_id" and record_type<>'reply_tasks') begin select raise(abort,'task parent must be a reply task'); end
